October 26, 1999

From ABCNewswire on Yahoo

Billboards Target Marijuana Use - (STATEWIDE) -- The Texas Commission on Alcohol and Drug Abuse is erecting billboards around the state to remind young Texans of the harmful effects of marijuana.

(Marijuananews note: Notice that "the harmful effects of marijuana" are -- just like the infallibility of Chairman Mao, or Hitler -- simply not to be questioned. That is not journalism.)

Commission Chairman James Oberwetter says new surveys show fewer teens recognize the dangers of marijuana. The billboards proclaim "We asked a group of pot smokers to come up with something clever for this billboard!" and the other side of the billboard is blank.

Most of the billboards will be near middle schools and high schools.

(Marijuananews note: This is the perfect example of prohibitionist propaganda. Of course, they did not ask "a group of pot smokers to come up with something clever" for any billboards." In other words it is a lie. Moreover, it is a violation of the 9th Commandment against giving false witness, since their objective is to incite state violence against marijuana users.

The kids won’t fall for it. On the contrary, they will be encouraged to try marijuana.

As for the cleverness of marijuana users….
